title: CodeMixBench: Evaluating Code-Mixing Capabilities of LLMs Across 18 Languages
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating code-mixing capabilities in LLMs across tasks such as language identification, machine translation, mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), knowledge reasoning (MMLU), and truthfulness (TruthfulQA). While MMLU contains some sub-tasks related to ethics, the paper does not specifically analyze or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its study.
